svg.title: One sky, many readers
svg.text: Sensing and coordination no single agency could afford or run alone: one map everyone reads from, one
queue, one backup plan, and one fair way to decide who flies first.
each brings its own layer and criteria
One map of Chicago, built once by the city
Grid, time, data format, where each reading came from, and why it was taken. Agencies add their own layers on top.
data is easy to share; flights, fleets and airspace are not
A city queue sends a sensor
a set time, then an audit.
its health layer and scenario watch (PT-WATCH), its criteria for asking for emergency mode, and its seat in joint exercises.
Checked by: the residents (no new agency or use joins without the purpose rules, the panels and a public vote) and by
operators' data, which is only reachable through the commons, so joining beats going alone.
